title: Act 2's status header text says 'Seven holds, seven unrested griefs' and lists seven (including Emberfall, 'the hold that was burned once'), but the very next line, 'The road: The Gray', says 'Six holds, six unrested griefs. Rest three... any opens Coldpass.' Nothing explains which of the seven is the odd one out or why the counts differ, which reads as a discrepancy on a first pass.
where: status command, Act 2 header vs. 'The road: The Gray' line
